name: autoobsidian
description: Claude-powered cloud notes bridge for Obsidian vaults via FNS API

scripts.web: bash -lc 'if [ -f ./local.config.sh ]; then source ./local.config.sh; fi; export TZ="${TZ:-Asia/Shanghai}" APP_TIME_ZONE="${APP_TIME_ZONE:-Asia/Shanghai}"; node web-terminal.js'
scripts.mcp: bash -lc 'if [ -f ./local.config.sh ]; then source ./local.config.sh; fi; python3 server.py'
